description: Web SPA SEO + admin SEO module. Adds a reusable Seo/JsonLd helper (titleTemplate + canonical + meta keywords/robots + Product/LocalBusiness/BreadcrumbList/Organization JSON-LD) seeded from config.seo; wires it into ProductDetails, Page and Home so humans + JS crawlers get per-page title/description/keywords/canonical + the SAME JSON-LD; adds the seoModule web flag; and adds a bilingual 'SEO' sub-tab to AdminSettings (modeled on FeaturesSettings) to manage global SEO defaults + LocalBusiness info, per-product SEO, per-CMS-page SEO, Google-snippet + social-card previews, a view-sitemap link and a robots-extra editor, saving via a new saveSeo() helper + existing saveProduct/savePage. Depends on FEAT-001 (consumes config.seo, the new product seo_* fields and POST /api/admin/seo), so it runs after FEAT-001.
steps: In 4astore-v2/web/src/lib/features.ts: append 'seoModule' to the FeatureKey union and FEATURE_KEYS array, and add a bilingual FEATURE_LABELS entry, e.g. seoModule: 'SEO module / एसईओ मॉड्यूल'.

In 4astore-v2/web/src/types.ts: add optional seo_title?: string, seo_description?: string, seo_keywords?: string, og_image?: string to interface Product; add optional `seo?` to interface StoreConfig matching the API SeoConfig shape (titleTemplate, defaultDescription, defaultKeywords, defaultOgImage, robotsExtra, social, business).
In 4astore-v2/web/src/lib/pages.ts: add metaKeywords: string to interface CmsPage (and PagePayload inherits it via Omit); ensure savePage sends metaKeywords through.

Create 4astore-v2/web/src/lib/seo.ts (and optionally src/components/Seo.tsx): interface SeoProps { title; description; keywords?; canonical?; robots?; image?; jsonLd?: object[] }; buildCanonical(path) using window.location.origin; pure builders productJsonLd(product, cfg, url), localBusinessJsonLd(cfg), breadcrumbJsonLd(items), organizationJsonLd(cfg) mirroring the API output; a <Seo> component wrapping react-helmet-async <Helmet> that emits title via cfg.titleTemplate ('%s | 4A Store'), meta description, meta keywords, <link rel=canonical>, meta robots, og:*/twitter:*, and one <script type="application/ld+json"> per jsonLd entry. Gate the extra JSON-LD behind isFeatureOn(features,'seoModule') while ALWAYS keeping title/description/canonical.

Rewire 4astore-v2/web/src/pages/ProductDetails.tsx: replace the inline <Helmet> with the shared Seo helper — title from seo_title||derived via titleTemplate, description = product.seo_description || product.description || derived, keywords = product.seo_keywords || derived, canonical '/product/:id', image = product.og_image || product.image, jsonLd = [productJsonLd, breadcrumbJsonLd, localBusinessJsonLd]. Read config via useConfig().

Extend 4astore-v2/web/src/pages/Page.tsx <Helmet>: add meta keywords from page.metaKeywords, keep canonical, add BreadcrumbList + LocalBusiness JSON-LD (via the shared helper); preserve the existing not-found noindex branch.
Extend 4astore-v2/web/src/pages/Home.tsx <Helmet>: title via titleTemplate, local description/keywords, canonical '/', and Organization + LocalBusiness JSON-LD via the shared helper.
In 4astore-v2/web/src/lib/admin.ts: add `export async function saveSeo(payload)` → (await api.post('/admin/seo', payload)).data, next to saveFeatures.

In 4astore-v2/web/src/pages/admin/AdminSettings.tsx: add { key: 'seo', label: '🔎 SEO' } to the SUBS const; add a function SeoSettings() modeled on FeaturesSettings() that reads useConfig().data.seo + useProducts() + usePages() and provides (a) global SEO defaults + LocalBusiness editor (titleTemplate, defaultDescription, defaultKeywords, defaultOgImage, social, business{address,phone,geo,openingHours,priceRange,areaServed}, robotsExtra) saved via saveSeo() with showToast + qc.invalidateQueries({queryKey:['config']}); (b) a searchable per-product SEO panel saving via saveProduct('update', {...seoTitle,seoDescription,seoKeywords,ogImage}); (c) per-CMS-page SEO via savePage('update', {...metaKeywords}); (d) a Google-snippet preview (title/description/url) and a social-card preview using ; (e) a 'view sitemap' link to /api/sitemap.xml and the robotsExtra editor. Reuse the file's lbl/inp/hint/albl styles; bilingual Hindi/English copy. Add {sub === 'seo' && } to the render block alongside the existing sub guards.
acceptance_criteria: `cd 4astore-v2/web && npm run build` completes successfully (tsc -b && vite build).

ProductDetails renders a <head> (via Helmet) with an SEO title (titleTemplate applied), meta description, meta keywords, <link rel=canonical> and a Product JSON-LD <script> (plus LocalBusiness when seoModule is ON).
Page.tsx emits meta keywords + canonical + BreadcrumbList/LocalBusiness JSON-LD; Home.tsx emits titleTemplate title + Organization/LocalBusiness JSON-LD.

The admin 'SEO' sub-tab appears in AdminSettings, loads global config.seo + per-product + per-page values, saves global SEO via POST /admin/seo, per-product via /admin/products, per-page via /admin/pages, and the Google-snippet + social-card previews render.
verification: Manually confirm (code review of the rendered <Helmet>/Seo output + a dev run if feasible) that ProductDetails/Page/Home emit the expected tags + JSON-LD and the admin SEO sub-tab wiring (SUBS entry, SeoSettings component, render guard, saveSeo in lib/admin.ts) is present and type-correct.
findings: IMPLEMENTED & VERIFIED (web): `npx tsc --noEmit` clean (0 errors) and `npm run build` (tsc -b && vite build) succeeds. Handoff for FEAT-003 (docs): == Admin UI entry point == SEO lives as a sub-tab inside Admin → Settings. SUBS entry { key: 'seo', label: '🔎 SEO' } added to web/src/pages/admin/AdminSettings.tsx (between 'features' and 'cache'), render guard {sub === 'seo' && }. The SeoSettings component holds 3 panels: (1) Global defaults + LocalBusiness (saves via POST /admin/seo → saveSeo), (2) Per-product SEO searchable panel (saves via POST /admin/products action 'update' with camelCase seoTitle/seoDescription/seoKeywords/ogImage), (3) Per-CMS-page keywords (saves via POST /admin/pages action 'update' with metaKeywords). Includes a Google-snippet preview, a social-card preview (), a 'view sitemap' link to /api/sitemap.xml and a robotsExtra editor. All copy bilingual Hindi/English. == File additions / edits (web) == NEW: web/src/lib/seo.ts (pure builders: applyTitleTemplate, buildCanonical, deriveProductSeo, productJsonLd, breadcrumbJsonLd, organizationJsonLd, localBusinessJsonLd — mirror api-node/src/seo/localSeo.ts). NEW: web/src/components/Seo.tsx ( wraps react-helmet-async ; ALWAYS emits title via titleTemplate + description + canonical + robots + OG/Twitter; extra JSON-LD gated behind isFeatureOn(features,'seoModule')). EDITED: web/src/lib/features.ts (seoModule flag + bilingual label), web/src/types.ts (Product.seo_title/seo_description/seo_keywords/og_image optional-nullable; new SeoConfig/SeoBusiness/SeoSocial exported; StoreConfig.seo?), web/src/lib/pages.ts (CmsPage.metaKeywords: string — PagePayload inherits via Omit; savePage passes it through), web/src/lib/admin.ts (saveSeo() → POST /admin/seo), web/src/pages/ProductDetails.tsx (inline Helmet replaced by with productJsonLd+breadcrumbJsonLd+localBusinessJsonLd), web/src/pages/Page.tsx (meta keywords + BreadcrumbList/LocalBusiness JSON-LD, canonical via buildCanonical), web/src/pages/Home.tsx (titleTemplate title + default keywords + canonical + Organization/LocalBusiness JSON-LD), web/src/pages/admin/AdminSettings.tsx (SEO sub-tab), web/src/pages/admin/AdminPages.tsx (blank() form seeds metaKeywords: '' since CmsPage.metaKeywords is now required in the type). == Behaviour notes for docs == The seoModule feature flag ONLY gates the extra schema.org JSON-LD scripts; basic SEO (title/description/keywords/canonical/OG) always renders so SEO never fully turns off. Per-page metaKeywords are read from the ADMIN pages list (fetchAdminPages / queryKey ['admin-pages']) because the public GET /api/pages list query omits meta_keywords. config.seo is always a complete object from the API, so the admin editor loads it directly. OG social-card preview uses the existing /api/og/image/product/:id endpoint (no new image pipeline). No new deps added (react-helmet-async already present).
